scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin,student "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:student"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sfz/admin && npm run build --workspace @sfz/student-app
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @sfz/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace @sfz/student-app
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/api.test.ts backend/tests/contracts.test.ts backend/tests/dispatch.test.ts backend/tests/ai-analytics.test.ts frontend/admin/tests/workflow.test.ts
scripts.test:backend: tsx --test backend/tests/contracts.test.ts backend/tests/api.test.ts backend/tests/ingest-notify.test.ts backend/tests/sandbox-roles-infographics.test.ts backend/tests/dispatch.test.ts backend/tests/ai-analytics.test.ts
